announced on Thursday a leadership transition, promoting Cliff Dennett from Chief Credit Officer to President and CEO, effective February 1, 2027.
Dennett will also join the BOD, succeeding Jeffrey D. Payne, who will become chairman.
Susan Black will become vice chairman, while outgoing vice chairman Ed Rossi will continue advising the board and the bank.
Dennett brings nearly 30 years of banking experience and will lead the bank as it targets the $1B milestone.

title: Pinnacle Bank promotes Cliff Dennett to CEO in leadership shake-up
